$comment: The yalive ecosystem's design tokens. This file is the only place a colour,
radius, or easing curve is decided. `generate.py` writes the per-app files
from it; nothing downstream should hardcode a value that lives here.
See DESIGN.md for the reasoning behind each group.

ground.$comment: The shared dark ground. Every app sits on it; the TUI inherits the terminal's own background and uses these only where it paints.

text.$comment: Three weights, and only three. A fourth would be a decision nobody can make consistently.

semantic.$comment: Shared across all four apps so green always means the same thing.

chart.$comment: Categorical colours for data — yGraphy tints one per note. Eight hues, spaced around the wheel at a lightness that stays legible on the dark ground and distinguishable from every accent, so a node is never mistaken for a selection.

brand.$comment: The disc every icon is drawn on.

accents.$comment: One hue per app, taken from its icon. Distinguishable at a glance in a dock, a tab bar, or a list of windows.

type.$comment: Three stacks. `reading` is for card bodies on the phone, where a serif genuinely reads better at length.
type.sans: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
type.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
type.reading: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Times New Roman", serif
